IGUI_KFM_Exam_HighFever: High fever. Many things can cause it.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_Fever: Feverish. Many things can cause it.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_Cold: Body is cold to the touch.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_WoundInflamed: %1: the wound looks inflamed, it may be getting infected.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_UnexplainedWeakness: Weaker than the visible wounds explain (blood loss, illness, hunger, exhaustion...).
IGUI_KFM_Exam_MoreSkill: With more First Aid skill you would notice more.
IGUI_KFM_Exam_Disclaimer: A field exam, not a lab: some things cannot be known.
IGUI_KFM_HelperHint: A helper next to the patient lowers the requirement by %1.
IGUI_KFM_MustRest: The patient must be sitting or lying down.
IGUI_KFM_Result_TourniquetOk: Tourniquet tight. Bleeding stopped for now.
IGUI_KFM_Result_TourniquetFail: Could not get the tourniquet tight enough.
IGUI_KFM_Result_CauterizeOk: Wound sealed. That will leave a mark.
IGUI_KFM_Result_CauterizeFail: Only burned it, the wound is still open.
IGUI_KFM_Result_ReduceOk: The bone is back in place.
IGUI_KFM_Result_ReduceFail: It did not go back in place. Made it worse.
IGUI_KFM_Result_DebrideOk: Infected tissue removed. Needs a bandage now.
IGUI_KFM_Result_DebrideFail: Could not remove all of it.
IGUI_KFM_SevereWarning: Severe complication suspected. Seek care now; neglected illness may cause gradual health loss.
IGUI_KFM_ConsentPrompt: %1 requests permission for Field Medicine care for one game hour. You can revoke it from your health menu.
IGUI_KFM_Recovery: Recovery estimate: %1 simulated hours. Follow up after treatment; not a Knox diagnosis.
IGUI_KFM_CareRequirements: Needs First Aid level %1 and the shown supply. Other patients must consent; rest for splinting, drying and rehabilitation.
IGUI_KFM_CareInterval: Minimum interval: %1 game hours. Supplies are consumed only after a useful, valid treatment.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Snapshot: This report records the examination moment. Re-examine after new symptoms or treatment; it is not a guarantee of health.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Urgent: Priority: a serious complication needs attention. Read its care plan and monitor the character.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_NoFindings: No additional active condition was identified in this report. Existing wounds and symptoms still deserve observation.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_ActiveCount: Active findings: %1. The most severe appear first.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Penalty: Active limitation — monitor its care plan
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Remaining: Estimated recovery remaining: about %1 game hours. Exposure and care can change this.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_CareIntro: Use the Field Medicine menu on the affected region for treatment. Requirements, supplies and intervals still apply; reading this report does not treat the character.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_CareInterval: Minimum interval: %1 game hours; First Aid required: %2.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_CareCap: Care benefit so far: %1%. Combined recovery assistance is capped at 40%; repeated treatment never gives an instant cure.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Wait: Wait at least %1 more game hours before repeating this care.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Ready: The interval has elapsed. Recheck supplies, skill and whether the care is still useful.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Review: Watch the symptoms, avoid further exposure and repeat the examination if the character worsens.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Prevention: Keep the character clean, rested, hydrated and protected from the weather. New symptoms are a reason to examine again.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideClimate: Climate: prolonged exposure matters. Seek shelter, dry wet clothing and use appropriate protection in heat or cold. Seasonal risks and exposure do not guarantee an illness.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideMask: Face protection: an appropriate face covering can reduce exposure. Keep it clean and combine it with hygiene; a mask never protects every wound or makes zombie contact safe.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideBlood: Blood: clean contaminated skin, face and wounds. Camouflage ending is not the same as washing. Cleaning stops further surface exposure but does not erase an illness already underway.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideMedicine: Medicines: choose care indicated for the condition. Antibacterial care is not a cure for a virus; symptom relief, wound care and recovery support have different roles. Respect the shown intervals.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideInjuries: Injuries: rest, protect the affected area and follow its care plan. Hand injuries can impair weapon handling. New pain or a worsening wound deserves another examination.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideMind: Mental strain: sleep, safety and a stable routine support gradual recovery. Some episodes include personal sounds or brief visual changes; they do not open real doors or change other players' lights. Recovery gives no character-creation points.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideProgress: Progress: reducing exposure, using appropriate care and following up helps. Offline time does not cause a burst of accumulated disease damage on reconnect.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_GuideWarning: Warnings: neglected severe complications can be fatal when enabled in sandbox. This game report never identifies the cause of the Knox infection or provides its cure.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Symptom_fainting: Risk of a brief collapse; avoid dangerous activity.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_flu: Rest and hydration support recovery. Monitor breathing and worsening fatigue; an antibacterial medicine does not treat the viral phase.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_viral: Use supportive care, fluids and hand hygiene. Avoid exposing other characters during close care.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_foodborne: Stop further food exposure, hydrate and use supportive care. The report does not duplicate native food sickness.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_wound: Clean the affected region and use the indicated wound care. Recheck if pain or infection progresses.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_deep: This wound complication needs appropriate antibacterial care and follow-up. Hygiene alone is no longer enough.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_systemic: A serious systemic complication needs prompt indicated care, rest and follow-up. Watch the warning and deterioration.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_respiratory: Monitor breathing, avoid exertion and use the indicated medicines and support. Severe neglected complications are dangerous.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_conjunctivitis: Clean exposed face and hands, avoid further contamination and follow the indicated eye-related care.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_dermatitis: Wash contaminated skin and use the indicated skin care. Stopping further exposure helps recovery.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_fungal: Keep the affected region clean and dry and use the indicated topical care.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_burn: Protect the region and use the burn dressing and follow-up. Improvement is limited and gradual.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_fracture: Rest, stabilize the region and follow the fracture procedure requirements. Treatment does not instantly restore the limb.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_muscle: True strain follows sustained exhausted workload, not ordinary exercise stiffness. Rest care (6h interval, no supply) eases symptoms; guided rehabilitation (12h, First Aid 2) consumes a wrap; support (4h) consumes a sachet. Active workload slows recovery. Combined care removes at most 40% of the baseline course; recovery remains gradual.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_nerve: Protect the region and follow rehabilitation over time. Recovery is slow; repeated actions do not stack unlimited benefits.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_coldHands: Warm and dry hands before warming care; use protective dressing. Hand pain affects native aiming and melee. Insulated intact gloves reduce future exposure.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_soreThroat: Get dry and warm; throat lozenges and supportive care ease symptoms gradually. Masks reduce relevant exposure, not every cause.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_mosquitoFever: Rest, hydration and limited fever/pain care help. Summer outdoor exposed skin is a risk; repellent and clothing help prevent exposure.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Hint_heatExhaustion: Move to a cooler place, rest and restore hydration. Severe neglected dehydration may cause a short blackout.
IGUI_KFM_Confidence_observations: Observations: symptoms and affected region only.
IGUI_KFM_Confidence_suspected: Suspected syndrome: uncertain; reassess after changes.
IGUI_KFM_Confidence_clinical: Clinical assessment: supported game finding, without laboratory or pathogen certainty.
IGUI_KFM_History_Intro: Latest 20 records, up to 64 retained. Examinations preserve what this observer knew then. Specific-care details are visible to the patient and the person who performed them; other observers receive a summary.
IGUI_KFM_History_CareHidden: Clinical care recorded; medication details are private to the patient and treating examiner.
IGUI_KFM_ColdHandsWarning: Hands/fingers remain cold and numb. Warm and dry them; pain impairs native aiming and melee. Seek protective care.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Symptom_toolEffort: Arm/forearm strain: native pain impairs weapon handling; actual tool swings add a small fatigue cost.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Symptom_mobility: Leg/foot strain increases endurance cost while moving. Rest stops this added cost; no artificial fracture or forced limp is applied.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Symptom_overload: Lower torso/back strain adds fatigue while moving above carrying capacity. Reduce the carried load and rest.
IGUI_KFM_Detail_Symptom_fatigue: Fatigue can reduce sustained activity; treatment limits the added burden.
IGUI_KFM_DynamicCare_respiratoryVulnerab: Breathing aid (6h interval) and paced rehabilitation (12h) help gradually. Rest and avoid prolonged respiratory strain; this model does not diagnose a real disease.
IGUI_KFM_DynamicCare_cardiacVulnerabilit: Support pack (8h) and paced rehabilitation (12h), hydration and rest. Severe exhaustion can cause a brief blackout; seek care before worsening.
IGUI_KFM_DynamicCare_hypervigilance: A quiet resting grounding routine (6h) or consented support consultation (12h) helps recovery. Alertness may improve exams while adding fatigue. Perceptions are personal, never physical door/light changes.
IGUI_KFM_DynamicCare_lowMood: Support consultation (12h), recovery-journal entries (8h), safe rest and time help recovery. Slower medical actions are a temporary game effect; no trait points change.
IGUI_KFM_DynamicCare_sleepDisruption: A sleep/rest routine (12h), quiet grounding (6h) and safe sleep help. This adds limited fatigue without replacing native sleeping-tablet or mood effects.
IGUI_KFM_DynamicCare_resilience: Healthy safe rest builds a temporary beneficial state: modest endurance recovery while resting and slightly faster medical actions. Prolonged strain can erode it; no trait-point reward.
